Printed edition: Narrative of travels in Europe, Asia, and Africa, in the seventeenth century, London : Printed for the Oriental translation fund of Great Britain and Ireland; sold by Parbury, Allen, & co., 1834, the Internet Archive scan https://archive.org/details/narrativeoftrave02evli.
